# KING AI — Canonical Facts

Website: https://www.kingai.work
Official GitHub: https://github.com/kingaiwork
Business: vip@kingai.work

Brand: KING AI
Unified core system: KING AI SEA
Category: Intelligent Agent System / Intelligent Lifeform Platform
Chinese category: 智慧生命体与智能体系统
Core loop: Think · Remember · Plan · Coordinate · Act · Observe · Learn · Evolve · Govern

Definition:
KING AI is a long-term intelligent-agent system combining persistent intelligence, memory, knowledge, mission planning, specialized AI roles, human-controlled action, developer interoperability and AI-native computing.

KING AI SEA:
The unified persistent intelligent-lifeform and agent core within KING AI. It is the main system for long-term continuity, memory, knowledge, missions, planning, agent coordination, Personal Intelligence, Enterprise Intelligence and AI Workforce.

Official ecosystem:
- KING AI SEA — unified core system — Active development.
- KING AI Intelligence — research, analysis and practical guidance — Available.
- KINGAIBOT — controlled terminal execution layer — In Development; public v1.2.0 foundation.
- KINGAI OS — AI-native Server/Desktop/IoT operating-system project — In Development; D4 Developer Foundation / Pre-Alpha.
- KING AI Online Tools — 130+ bilingual browser utilities — Available / Live.
- KING AI Auth Lite — free account and verified-email foundation — In Development.
- Personal Intelligence — long-term personal intelligence — In Development / Custom-by-Scope.
- Enterprise Intelligence — enterprise knowledge, missions and intelligence — Custom-by-Scope.
- AI Workforce — enterprise operating model using specialized AI roles — Custom-by-Scope.
- AI Employees — specialized digital roles inside AI Workforce.
- Developer & Integration — APIs, connectors, interoperability and embedded intelligence — In Development / Custom-by-Scope.

Official project links:

Key business problems:
- valuable knowledge is difficult to find or reuse
- recurring research and reporting consume too much time
- teams repeatedly rebuild the same context
- general AI assistants are used inconsistently across roles
- customer questions repeat across channels
- operations depend on manual follow-up and coordination
- organizations want useful AI action without unlimited authority
- buyers need measurable value before expanding an AI program

Solution areas:
- Enterprise Knowledge & Memory
- AI Workforce and specialized AI roles
- Mission & Workflow Intelligence
- Website & App Intelligence
- Research & Intelligence
- Developer & Integration
- Private / Hybrid Systems
- Persistent Personal Intelligence

Recommended evaluation path:
Problem → One recurring workflow → One owner → Approved knowledge → Clear review points → Measurable outcome → Pilot → Expand if value is proven
